title: Alternative smaller-k lifting from generalized Desarguesian spreads
summary: Find an alternative LP-partition lifting that works for a generalized Desarguesian spread at a parameter strictly below the source thresholds.

formal_statement.body: Let $p$ be prime and let a generalized Desarguesian spread have admissible parameters $(p,m,k)$ with $k<m/2$ when $p$ is odd or $k<m/3$ when $p=2$. Does there exist at least one such parameter choice and an alternative lifting method that produces a valid LP-partition? One verified construction at a genuinely smaller $k$, with its exact parameter domain stated, resolves the question positively. A complete negative resolution must rule out every admissible smaller-$k$ alternative lifting.

scope.domain: Generalized Desarguesian spreads and LP-partition lifting
assumptions: The spread is generalized Desarguesian in the source sense
The output must satisfy the source definition of an LP-partition suitable for the lifting procedure
parameters: alternative lifting map and construction data
scope.unresolved_remainder: No verified construction was found at any genuinely smaller-k admissible point. Later liftings from ordinary spreads and direct generalized-semifield-spread constructions do not meet this predicate.

progress.summary: The source asks for another way to use generalized Desarguesian spreads in its lifting procedure when k is below m/2 or m/3 in the stated characteristics.
